alternative_explanations: Any apparent benefit may arise from random label embeddings or ordinary 256-label global fitting rather than layer-local credit.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus hash or byte-length mismatch.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives paths, roles, offsets, future bytes or another test slot's state.
Invalidate if test updates change shared slow state or tuning occurs after scoring output.
Invalidate if a mandatory PPM, CTW, LZ or dense autoregressive control is absent.
Invalidate if the three neural roles differ in topology, constants, initialization, data order, update count, input representation or output rule beyond credit assignment.
Invalidate if layer_local_goodness_byte executes a reverse gradient or reads later-layer weights during an earlier-layer update.

confounds: The visible single-repository corpus is small; one wrong label per positive is weak supervision and exhaustive 256-label query scoring may dominate cost.
falsification_criteria: Discard if any K/D cell has layer-local mean, cold or worst-file bpb more than 0.1671047931063159 above source-identical global credit.
Discard if layer-local does not strictly improve mean, cold and worst-file bpb over frozen hidden in every K/D cell.
Discard unless layer-local fit ops or fit peak bytes are strictly lower than global credit while query ops and resident state are no higher.
Discard if any complete simpler control Pareto-dominates layer-local on frozen quality and full-cost axes.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify this exact Forward-Forward byte rule without changing width, initialization, epoch, batch, learning rate, threshold, negative construction or query rule.
outcome_policy.null: End the exact rule if both neural training routes fail or simpler universal coders dominate capability and full cost.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication in a later wake.

predicted_outcome: At identical PCG64(seed xor 0x46465744) normal-scale-0.05 initialization, chronological one epoch, batch 128, learning rate 0.02, tanh, goodness threshold 0.5 and deterministic wrong=(target+1+((sum(context)+17*len(context)) mod 255)) mod 256, layer-local is expected to reduce fit work but lose more than 0.1671047931063159 bpb to global credit or be dominated by PPM-D/CTW.
promotion_criteria: One seed cannot promote; only the full conjunction can authorize unchanged three-seed adversarial replication.
research_question: With one source-identical model using a 64-byte left-padded context represented by 64 byte/255 scalars plus 64 presence bits, tanh widths 8/8, 256 label embeddings and a shared sum-of-squared-layer-goodness softmax query, can layer-local positive/negative training preserve global-credit capability at lower fit work?
